business: A local capture retains only explicitly bound original inputs. Its source catalog records local-reference standing; explicit retention assertion does not establish external permission or authenticated authority.
bridge: AlchLang selects reserved control paths, binding discovery schema and opaque fields, count/byte bounds, evidence population and all capture/catalog/encoding projections. Shared adapters read anchored bytes, invoke native exact-binding and privacy checks, and encode source-selected records.
system: Deduplicate logical paths against immutable observed bytes; each declared binding must match that same observation. Sort logical paths for deterministic catalog entries. Build the exact encoding and catalog control records, then source-selected input rows and capture metadata. Do not discover or retain unrelated files.
scope: Current CLI local source-root capture first; externally supplied catalogs and stateless API frames require their own full parity proofs.
